features: Synchronizes Test Automated Judge scoring limits with the live Automated Scoring rules
Test judge links now enforce the configured YES maximum separately for Leaders and Followers
Test judge links now enforce A1, A2 and A3 as unique selections, maximum once each per judge per role
Adds server-side validation so Test judge limits cannot be bypassed by manipulating the browser form
Adds browser-side immediate warnings when a test judge attempts an extra YES or duplicate A1/A2/A3
Test judge screen displays live role counters for YES, A1, A2 and A3 usage
Adds Generate Valid Random Scores directly to the Test judge hyperlink screen
Random Test judge generation produces exactly the configured YES count plus unique A1/A2/A3 where enough competitors exist
Submitting a Test judge sheet requires exactly the configured YES count for each role the judge is assigned to
All Test judge data remains isolated in bdc_test_* tables and cannot affect official BDC scoring or points
